newsitem.title: USA: Sensormatic shareholders approve board, stock plan.
newsitem.headline: Sensormatic shareholders approve board, stock plan.

text.p: Sensormatic Electronics Corp said on Tuesday its shareholders elected two directors to its board and voted to boost the number of shares the company issued under a 1995 stock incentive plan.

The shareholders, at their annual meeting November 22, elected Ronald Assaf and Arthur Milnes to the company's board, Sensormatic said. Assaf was reelected chairman at a subsequent board meeting, it added. The two received votes from 77 percent of the 87 percent of shareholders who voted.

The company will also boost the number of shares it issued under its 1995 stock incentive plan by 2 million, it said. The measure was approved by 66 percent of the 86 percent of shareholders who voted on it. The company did not say how many shares are currently outstanding under the 1995 plan.
Sensormatic officials were not immediately available to comment.
